card.name: Start of Z-brand drug names; Dutch example text
card.fires_on: The letter Z beginning a capitalized brand name (Zydus, ZAVZPRET, ZTLIDO, ZELAPAR, ZEPATIER) right after words like 'of', 'with' or 'received'. It also fires on the first word of Dutch example sentences in a language-learning list about dimmen.

modes.label: Z starting a brand name
modes.description: A split-off capital Z that opens an all-caps or capitalized drug brand name after a preposition or verb.
modes.example: Co-administration of moderate or strong inducers of CYP3A with<< Z>>EPATIER may decrease elbasvir
